Thanks again for taking the time today, Elena — good conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with the Exec team and procurement.

Call highlights (3):
- Platform fit: Datastream’s primary goal is sub-100ms median latency for query-style generation and predictable per-token economics for batch embedding workflows. Redwood’s Dedicated and caching profile align with those targets.
- Decision criteria: 1) latency SLOs, 2) per-token cost at scale, 3) data residency & auditability, 4) integration with existing ETL (Kafka).
- Stakeholders you mentioned: Marcos (economic sponsor), security leads (SOC2 / data residency), and procurement.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the preferred procurement contact and the security LA contact so we can route docs and NDA.
2) We’ll send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a concise one-pager for Marcos — Rachael-approved executive blurb + 1-slide ROI.
3) Laura (CS/solutions) and I will draft a champion enablement pack with talk tracks and a two-week pilot success criteria document.

I’ve attached a short "Platform fit" one-pager and a MAP template to this thread. If Marcos is available, propose a 30-min alignment with him next week to lock budget / timeline.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate timelines once you confirm contacts.

--
Rishi Malhotra
